game_title: Arithmetic Cannon – Crater Lake Edge Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the lava scout must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on lava imps.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: In Crater Lake Edge, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on lava imps. Each round, a new cooling flasks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the damage value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 320 points of cooling flasks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 320, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 10 (extended tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Crater Lake Edge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how damage changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Crater Lake Edge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 320 within 80 seconds.
